title: Quick check: Managing Application Configuration

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “Managing Application Configuration”?
options: Environment-specific values should be understood by relating the input to the resulting UI and its observable behavior.
The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
questions.answer_key: Environment-specific values should be understood by relating the input to the resulting UI and its observable behavior.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Managing Application Configuration: Environment-specific values should be understood by relating the input to the resulting UI and its observable behavior.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Environment-specific values?
options: Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
Test both the expected case and an edge/failure case and explain the result.
questions.answer_key: Test both the expected case and an edge/failure case and explain the result.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Managing Application Configuration: Test both the expected case and an edge/failure case and explain the result.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “Managing Application Configuration” complete?
options: Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in Managing Application Configuration: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
